changelog:
Initial release with comprehensive log analysis features.

- Intelligent monitoring of cron jobs, system, and application logs
- Automatic error detection and categorization
- Pattern analysis and trend detection
- Report generation (real-time, daily, weekly), with summaries and performance metrics
- Discord notifications for important alerts and reports
- Configurable rules and log sources for flexible usage
